title: Tracks
description: Songs generated in the Music app. Each row captures the prompt (style tags + optional lyrics) and, once the HeartMuLa engine finishes, links `audioFileId` to the rendered audio stored in core's `files` collection. The `status` field tracks the async generation lifecycle (generating → ready / failed).

ai.purpose: Stores AI-generated music: the prompt (style `tags` and optional `lyrics`) plus the rendered audio (as a `files` row) and the generation status.
ai.howItWorks: The `MusicStudioPrefab` POSTs `{title, lyrics, tags, durationMs}` to `/music-api/api/generate`. The music-api immediately creates a `music_tracks` row with `status: generating` and returns its id, then runs HeartMuLa in the background. When generation completes it uploads the audio to core's `/api/files/uploadDirect` and patches the row to `status: ready` with `audioFileId` set; on error it sets `status: failed` and `error`. The frontend polls the row until it leaves the `generating` state.
ai.manipulation: Create rows through the Studio prefab (which drives the generation pipeline). You can edit `title` freely. Do not hand-edit `status`, `audioFileId`, or `error` — they are managed by the generation job. Delete a row to remove it from the library (this does NOT delete the underlying `files` audio).

outcomes.how: Open the Music Studio, enter style tags (e.g. `lofi,piano,chill`) and optionally lyrics with [Verse]/[Chorus] markers, pick a length, and click Generate. A `music_tracks` row is created in the `generating` state and flips to `ready` with playable audio when the engine finishes.

warnings: Generation is roughly real-time — a 2-minute song takes ~2 minutes. A row can sit in `generating` for a while; that is expected.
Deleting a `music_tracks` row does NOT delete the underlying `files` audio record. Delete the file separately if needed.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short label for the track. Defaults to a name derived from the style tags when generated from the Studio.

tags.title: Style tags
tags.description: Comma-separated style/mood/instrument tags passed to the generator, e.g. `piano,happy,wedding,romantic`. Drives the musical character of the song.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Optional lyrics with section markers ([Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]). Leave empty for an instrumental. HeartMuLa sings these in the generated track.

status.title: Status
status.description: Generation lifecycle state. Backend-managed: `generating` while the engine renders, `ready` once audio is attached, `failed` if generation errored.

audioFileId.title: Audio
audioFileId.description: The rendered song, stored as a row in core's `files` collection (audio/mpeg). Backend-managed: set when generation completes.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Music-generation engine that produced this track. Currently always `heartmula`.

durationMs.title: Duration (ms)
durationMs.description: Requested/approximate length of the track in milliseconds.

mimeType.title: MIME type
mimeType.description: MIME type of the stored audio (audio/mpeg). Cached for fast list rendering.

error.title: Error
error.description: Populated by the generation job when `status` is `failed` — the upstream error message.
